items.title: Launching the Vite Ecosystem Fund

sentences.en: Launching the Vite Ecosystem Fund.
sentences.zh: 启动VITE生态系统基金。

sentences.en: Cloudflare is distributing the first $301,300 of the Vite Ecosystem Fund to 44 projects and maintainers across the Vite ecosystem.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare将向VITE生态系统中的44个项目和维护者分发VITE生态系统基金的第一笔301,300 $。

sentences.en: When VoidZero joined Cloudflare, we committed $1 million to strengthen the open source ecosystem around Vite.
sentences.zh: 当VoidZero加入Cloudflare时，我们投入了100万$来加强围绕Vite的开源生态系统。

sentences.en: This round is just the start.
sentences.zh: 这才仅仅是一个开始。

sentences.en: Sponsoring open source has always mattered, but now AI has made funding urgent.
sentences.zh: 赞助开源一直很重要，但现在人工智能已经迫切需要资金。

sentences.en: AI is changing open source AI has made open source more valuable while triggering more maintainer burnout.
sentences.zh: 人工智能正在改变开源人工智能，使开源更有价值，同时引发更多的维护人员倦怠。

sentences.en: Previously, contributing to a project through either an issue or pull request meant you cared about it.
sentences.zh: 以前，通过问题或拉取请求为项目做出贡献意味着您关心它。

sentences.en: In return, maintainers would review and provide feedback.
sentences.zh: 作为回报，维护人员将审核并提供反馈。

sentences.en: AI changed the social contract of open source.
sentences.zh: 人工智能改变了开源的社会契约。

sentences.en: Anyone can now create and submit AI-authored pull requests.
sentences.zh: 现在，任何人都可以创建和提交人工智能撰写的拉取请求。

sentences.en: The most visible result is the influx of pull requests.
sentences.zh: 最明显的结果是拉取请求的涌入。

sentences.en: As the number of PRs has gone up, the number of maintainers reviewing them has stayed constant.
sentences.zh: 随着PR数量的增加，审核它们的维护者数量保持不变。

items.title: Families who fled Ethiopia for Kenya’s Moyale need food, water and shelter

sentences.en: Families who fled Ethiopia for Kenya’s Moyale need food, water and shelter.
sentences.zh: 逃离埃塞俄比亚前往肯尼亚莫亚莱的家庭需要食物、水和住所。

sentences.en: The International Organization of Migration (IOM) and partners are calling for urgent funding to support tens of thousands of people who have escaped violent clashes in Ethiopia for the Moyale region in northern Kenya.
sentences.zh: 国际移民组织（ IOM ）及其合作伙伴呼吁提供紧急资金，为肯尼亚北部莫亚莱地区逃离埃塞俄比亚暴力冲突的数万人提供支持。

items.title: COP31 opens in Antalya: Can climate promises finally deliver results?

sentences.en: COP31 opens in Antalya: Can climate promises finally deliver results?.
sentences.zh: COP31在安塔利亚开幕：气候承诺最终能否取得成果？

sentences.en: Nearly 200 countries have arrived on Türkiye's Mediterranean coast for a climate summit with a different ambition: fewer grand declarations and more concrete decisions.
sentences.zh: 近200个国家抵达土耳其地中海沿岸参加气候峰会，其雄心壮志与众不同：更少的宏伟宣言和更具体的决定。

sentences.en: With a powerful El Niño threatening to worsen extreme weather, negotiators face difficult questions over climate finance, clean energy and how to protect communities already living with the consequences of climate change.
sentences.zh: 由于强大的厄尔尼诺现象有可能恶化极端天气，谈判代表在气候融资、清洁能源以及如何保护已经生活在气候变化后果中的社区方面面临着棘手的问题。

items.title: Children among the dead as heavy rains flood tents and shelters in Gaza

sentences.en: Children among the dead as heavy rains flood tents and shelters in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 加沙的大雨淹没了帐篷和庇护所，死者中有儿童。

sentences.en: An infant reportedly drowned and five Gazans were killed – including three children – when a sand dune collapsed on their tents as the first heavy rains swept across the enclave at the weekend, according to the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).
sentences.zh: 据联合国援助协调办公室（ OCHA ）称，据报道，周末第一场大雨席卷飞地时，沙丘坍塌在他们的帐篷上，导致一名婴儿溺水，五名加沙人死亡，其中包括三名儿童。

items.title: World News in Brief: El Niño’s $11 trillion price tag, Mozambique and Yemen updates

sentences.en: World News in Brief: El Niño’s $11 trillion price tag, Mozambique and Yemen updates.
sentences.zh: 《世界新闻简报》：厄尔尼诺现象11万亿美元的价格，莫桑比克和也门的最新消息。

sentences.en: The El Niño extreme weather pattern could cost the global economy up to $11 trillion and seriously impact food security, said the UN agency tackling rural poverty in developing countries on Monday.
sentences.zh: 联合国负责解决发展中国家农村贫困问题的机构周一表示，厄尔尼诺现象极端天气模式可能使全球经济损失高达11万亿美元，并严重影响粮食安全。

items.title: At least 56 migrants die in weekend shipwrecks off Senegal and Greece

sentences.en: At least 56 migrants die in weekend shipwrecks off Senegal and Greece.
sentences.zh: 至少有56名移民在塞内加尔和希腊附近的周末海难中丧生。

sentences.en: At least 56 people died in a series of shipwrecks off Senegal and Greece over the weekend, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said on Monday, calling it a stark reminder of the deadly risks they face on the Atlantic and Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 国际移民组织（ IOM ）周一表示，上周末在塞内加尔和希腊海域发生的一系列沉船事故中，至少有56人丧生，这清楚地提醒人们，他们在大西洋和地中海面临着致命的风险。

items.title: Deadly floods hit Iraq as thunderstorms sweep across region

sentences.zh: 随着雷暴席卷整个地区，致命的洪水袭击了伊拉克。

sentences.en: Violent storms lash northern Iraq and parts of Iran, while Portugal faces strong winds and Japan braces for further snowfall Deadly flash floods hit northern Iraq on Saturday as severe thunderstorms swept across the region, including in neighbouring Iran.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨席卷伊拉克北部和伊朗部分地区，而葡萄牙面临强风，日本为进一步降雪做准备周六伊拉克北部发生致命的山洪暴发，包括邻国伊朗在内的严重雷暴席卷该地区。

sentences.en: The city of Erbil, in Iraq, was particularly badly hit, with extensive damage to homes and businesses.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克的埃尔比勒市遭受了特别严重的打击，房屋和企业受到了广泛的破坏。

sentences.en: Streets were inundated as torrential rain fell over a short period.
sentences.zh: 由于暴雨在短时间内降下，街道被淹没。

sentences.en: Rainfall exceeded forecasts, with an estimated 80mm falling in the city, compared with expectations of 30mm.
sentences.zh: 降雨量超过预测，该市估计降雨量为80毫米，而预期为30毫米。

sentences.en: Two people were killed in the floods.

items.title: Pope Leo delivers stinging rebuke of Milei’s austerity measures during Argentina visit

sentences.en: Pope Leo delivers stinging rebuke of Milei’s austerity measures during Argentina visit.
sentences.zh: 在阿根廷访问期间，教皇利奥对米莱的紧缩措施提出了尖锐的指责。

sentences.en: Pontiff tells Argentina’s president the economy must benefit all on second stop of 12-day Latin America tour Pope Leo XIV has delivered a stinging critique of Argentine president Javier Milei’s harsh austerity measures, insisting growth must benefit all in a speech met with rapturous applause in Buenos Aires.
sentences.zh: 教皇告诉阿根廷总统，在为期12天的拉丁美洲之旅的第二站，教皇利奥十四世对阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱（ Javier Milei ）的严厉紧缩措施提出了尖锐的批评，坚持认为增长必须在布宜诺斯艾利斯的热烈掌声中使所有人受益。

sentences.en: “The economy must be at the service of the people, rather than people being at the service of the economy,” he said on Sunday, shortly after landing in Argentina on the second leg of a Latin America tour.
sentences.zh: “经济必须为人民服务，而不是人民为经济服务，”他在拉美之旅的第二站登陆阿根廷后不久于周日表示。

items.title: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence

sentences.en: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence.
sentences.zh: 英伟达（ Nvidia ）在报告首席执行官黄延森（ Jensen Huang ）成为外国情报目标后展开调查。

sentences.en: CEO reportedly ‌had close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing Nvidia said ⁠on Sunday it “is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort”.
sentences.zh: 据报道，首席执行官与一位向北京英伟达传递信息的中国女商人有着密切的关系，该女商人周日表示， “鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄延森（ Jensen Huang ）一直是外国情报工作的目标，该公司正在启动一项独立调查”。

sentences.en: The New York Times reported in ​October that Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence that Huang ‌had a close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》去年10月报道称，唐纳德·特朗普去年听取了有关情报的简报，称黄与一名向北京传递信息的中国女商人有着密切的关系。

items.title: Gadi Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies as he strives to form government

sentences.en: Gadi Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies as he strives to form government.
sentences.zh: 加迪·艾森科特（ Gadi Eisenkot ）在努力组建政府时向内塔尼亚胡的盟友伸出援手。

sentences.en: Former military chief says prime minister brought Israel to historic crisis and it is approaching ‘point of no return’ Israel’s former military chief Gadi Eisenkot started the tough task of forming a government on Sunday, reaching out to Benjamin Netanyahu’s allies as he said the veteran prime minister had brought the country to a historic crisis.
sentences.zh: 前军事总理表示，总理将以色列带入历史性危机，以色列前军事总理加迪·艾森科特（ Gadi Eisenkot ）周日开始组建政府的艰巨任务，向本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）的盟友伸出援手，他说这位资深总理已将该国带入历史性危机。

sentences.en: Eisenkot, 66, the leader of the Yashar party, who has vowed to bridge Israel’s deep polarisation under Netanyahu, formally received a mandate from the president, Isaac Herzog, who gave him 28 days to form a government despite his bloc lacking a clear majority.
sentences.zh: 66岁的Eisenkot是Yashar党的领导人，他发誓要在内塔尼亚胡的领导下弥合以色列的深刻两极分化，他正式接受了总统Isaac Herzog的授权，尽管他的集团缺乏明显的多数，但他给了他28天的时间来组建政府。

items.title: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven

sentences.en: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven.
sentences.zh: 两列火车在埃及相撞，造成至少7人死亡。

sentences.en: President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.
sentences.zh: 官员说，在距离开罗约50公里的al-Ayyat的一列火车出轨后，总统下令立即进行调查。周日，两列火车在埃及首都开罗以南发生碰撞，造成7人死亡，至少125人受伤。

sentences.en: The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.
sentences.zh: 据交通部称，事故发生在开罗以南约50公里（ 30英里）的吉萨省al-Ayyat区，当时一列前往法尤姆省的火车撞上了前往南部阿斯旺省的火车后部。

items.title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt

sentences.en: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 镜头显示埃及致命的火车事故后出轨的车厢。

sentences.en: At least seven people died when two trains collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.
sentences.zh: 当两列火车相撞时，至少有七人死亡，导致几节车厢脱轨并从路堤上坠落。
